# Internal Service Policy Extract

## Eligibility

Internal service channels are available to workforce members with an active
organizational account. Requests submitted on behalf of third parties must be
entered by an accountable employee.

## Approval

An employee's line manager must approve every service request before work
starts. The service owner may waive approval during a declared operational
incident.

## Response

The receiving service team must acknowledge a valid request within five
working days.

## Records

Request records are retained for seven years after closure. Attachments follow
the same retention period unless a stricter information rule applies.

The policy owner recorded this extract as current during the previous annual
review.
